hooks.command: if [ "$LG_ACP" = 1 ]; then printf '{"decision":"deny","reason":"Direct file edits and shell commands are disabled in lg; use paint_edit, lg_write_file, or lg_run."}'; else printf '{"decision":"allow"}'; fi

if [ "$LG_ACP" != 1 ]; then printf '{"decision":"allow"}'; else python3 -c 'import json,os,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=os.path.realpath(os.path.expanduser(d.get("toolCall",{}).get("args",{}).get("Path",""))); base=os.path.realpath(os.path.expanduser("~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/mcp"))+os.sep; print(json.dumps({"decision":"allow"} if p.startswith(base) else {"decision":"deny","reason":"Direct file reads are disabled in lg; use read_buffer, lg_grep, or lg_glob."}))'; fi
